description: History Flow as a stacked bar: X = revision (column), stack = lines in document order, color = author. Column height is proportional to content size; y is inverted so the document starts at the top. No x-axis. Width rule: chart width grows sub-linearly (sqrt) so per-column width shrinks as revision count rises; here 6 revisions -> width 15 (~2.5px/column).

title.subtitle: columns = revisions, stack = lines, color = original author (provenance)
